funnel.note_en: Deduplicated by arXiv ID, DOI or paper URL; identities and compression relevance are not all verified.
funnel.note_zh: 按论文编号或链接去重；含待核对记录，还没逐篇确认是否属于推理压缩。

funnel.note_en: Direct plus adjacent candidates from an older machine batch; not confirmed relevant papers.
funnel.note_zh: 程序按标题筛出的直接相关或相邻工作；还需要读原文，不能当成已经读过。

funnel.note_en: Abstract and selected method/results checks retain their own scopes; not full-paper reviews or reproductions.
funnel.note_zh: 有的读过摘要，有的核对过方法和实验；两者分开记录，不代表都读完全文或做过实验。

funnel.note_en: Includes classical, mechanism, context and boundary evidence; not a count of deployed algorithms.
funnel.note_zh: 已用于解释原理、比较方法或形成判断；引用论文不等于已经在业务中用起来。

limits_en: This audits maintained inventory, not complete or current field coverage.
Stages have different units and the old pipeline is not fully reconciled; do not interpret ratios as conversion rates.
arXiv and conference aliases may remain distinct without explicit mappings; identifier deduplication is not work-level deduplication.
No independent reproduction or target-platform measurement is asserted; selected-section checks are not full-paper reviews.
limits_zh: 这是已维护数据的库存盘点，不是全领域最新或完整覆盖声明。
四个环节采用不同口径，且旧漏斗尚未与后续专题全部对账，不能直接相除当作转化率。
同一论文的 arXiv 与会议版本缺少显式别名时仍可能分别计数；标识去重不等于作品级完全去重。
没有独立复现或目标平台实测结论；章节核对不等于全文审阅。
